s1.desc: a living room with a cream couch facing a television

spans.view: with a fish-print blanket over the couch and the back of a teal television in the foreground

beats.text: Pax and Polly sit side by side on the couch and pull the fish-print blanket up to their chests
Pax shuts his eyes with a smile and nestles under the blanket while Polly looks ahead
Pax and Polly sit snug under the blanket, both looking ahead with open eyes
Polly shuts her eyes with a smile while Pax looks ahead beside her
Pax picks up a bag of chips on the left while Polly takes a striped popcorn box from the right
Polly munches popcorn with her eyes shut while Pax holds his chip bag, watching ahead
Pax leans to the left armrest and picks up a small teal remote while Polly holds her popcorn box, watching ahead
Pax holds the remote pointed ahead while Polly dips into her popcorn box and eats
Pax leans left and sets the remote back on the armrest while Polly stuffs popcorn into her beak
Pax reaches into his chip bag while Polly holds her popcorn, watching ahead
Pax eats chips from his bag with a flipper at his beak while Polly holds her popcorn, watching
Pax and Polly sit still under the blanket, staring ahead with wide eyes

spans.notes: single locked shot (compare f8/f362 and f100/f250: couch outline, arms and remote overlap exactly). Split at f158 because Polly jumps from sitting to asleep between f157 and f158 with no in-between frames (time-skip jump cut in the same framing; d1 only 2.8 so the cut detector misses it). The grey-lavender wall and the glow around the TV read as evening | verification pass 2 (verify2_report_2): beat 10-26 says both have their eyes closed: they never are at the same time (Pax's eyes shut only f7-13, both open f14-20, Polly's shut f21-26 while Pax's are open); phrasing also near v8 'eyes closed in a happy smile'; beat 64-96 says Polly keeps eating popcorn: f64-82 she only holds the box with her eyes open, watching; she eats from ~f80; beat 96-118: Polly stops stuffing popcorn at ~f109 and

spans.view: with a fish-print blanket over the couch and the back of a teal television in the foreground

beats.text: Polly lies slumped asleep against the right armrest, her popcorn box tipped over, while Pax holds his chip bag, staring ahead
Pax keeps watching with his chip bag in his flippers while Polly sleeps on, limp against the armrest
Pax munches a chip and turns toward the sleeping Polly, lowering his bag
Pax leans over Polly and nudges her shoulder with his flipper while she stays limp and asleep
Pax pats Polly on the head with one flipper, looking down at her
Pax settles back beside the sleeping Polly with a resigned look and a slow blink
Pax leans down toward the popcorn spilled on the blanket and scoops some up
Pax munches the popcorn with a flipper at his beak and gazes ahead contentedly

spans.notes: same locked shot after the f158 jump cut
